rows.note: This is the everyday colloquial choice for saying that someone is fired.

example.english: The company gave me the sack.
example.jyutping: ngo5 bei2 gaan1 gung1 si1 caau2 jau4 jyu2 laa3

rows.note: Use this formal verb when describing dismissal in professional, official, or written contexts.

example.english: The company decided to sack that employee.
example.traditional: 公司決定解僱該名員工。
example.jyutping: gung1 si1 kyut3 ding6 gaai2 gu3 goi1 ming4 jyun4 gung1

rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for putting groceries or other items into a bag.

example.english: After shopping, remember to put the groceries in the sack and don't leave anything out.
example.traditional: 買完餸要記得入袋，唔好漏咗。
example.jyutping: maai5 jyun4 sung3 jiu3 gei3 dak1 jap6 doi6 m4 hou2 lau6 zo2
